messages.subject: Project Falcon - legal DD request list
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan, Amelia,

Following the opening of the data room, please find below our initial legal due diligence request list (also uploaded to the data room as document 0.1). Priority items are corporate constitutional documents, the top 10 customer and supplier contracts, the property lease for Unit 7, employment particulars, and any litigation correspondence.

We'd particularly like early sight of anything relating to customer concentration and any ongoing HMRC matters. Happy to discuss scoping.

Kind regards
Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
